- User report: "Jordi's deployment boundary for the Zenod repository, 7 September 2026: this repository is for live Zenod production images, plus the default Phylax companion for WhatsApp when appropriate, and nothing else." [Log/2026-09-06.md#^e-7c5eb9](https://github.com/AlfaBlok/obsidian-brain/blob/c906053fe23f8fb34d2c7ef154cf3ce6c9cdb5ba/Log/2026-09-06.md#%5Ee-7c5eb9). - User report: "Epaminon, Outbound, Callisthenes, x-mcp and other independent agents should have their own repositories and deployment lifecycles." [Log/2026-09-06.md#^e-7c5eb9](https://github.com/AlfaBlok/obsidian-brain/blob/c906053fe23f8fb34d2c7ef154cf3ce6c9cdb5ba/Log/2026-09-06.md#%5Ee-7c5eb9). Effective: unknown; evidence captured: 2026-09-06T22:37:00. Verification scope: unknown.
- User report: "Until that separation is done, keep their automatic deployments from this repository disabled." [Log/2026-09-06.md#^e-7c5eb9](https://github.com/AlfaBlok/obsidian-brain/blob/c906053fe23f8fb34d2c7ef154cf3ce6c9cdb5ba/Log/2026-09-06.md#%5Ee-7c5eb9). Effective: unknown; evidence captured: 2026-09-06T22:37:00. Verification scope: unknown.
- User report: "Preserve their running services and data." [Log/2026-09-06.md#^e-7c5eb9](https://github.com/AlfaBlok/obsidian-brain/blob/c906053fe23f8fb34d2c7ef154cf3ce6c9cdb5ba/Log/2026-09-06.md#%5Ee-7c5eb9). Effective: unknown; evidence captured: 2026-09-06T22:37:00. Verification scope: unknown.
- User report: "Keep Zenod upgrades small, explicit and easy to undo." [Log/2026-09-06.md#^e-7c5eb9](https://github.com/AlfaBlok/obsidian-brain/blob/c906053fe23f8fb34d2c7ef154cf3ce6c9cdb5ba/Log/2026-09-06.md#%5Ee-7c5eb9).
